mechanics.claim: Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets from one cast, but take less damage from rockets beyond the first that hit them.
mechanics.quote: Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets, but receive less damage from ones beyond the first.

mechanics.claim: For the R-upgraded Hextech Rocket Swarm, champions take less damage from the 2nd-5th rockets that hit them, and even less (halved) from rockets beyond the 5th, across the 4 waves fired.
mechanics.quote: Champions and monsters receive less damage from the second to fifth rockets that hit them, which is reduced by {{ap|0.5*100}}% for rockets beyond the fifth.

mechanics.claim: Each rocket hitting a champion grants 20% beam charge to nearby Heimerdinger turrets, up to 100% from 5 rockets, which is a separate mechanic from this ability's own damage but affects turret (Q) damage output.
mechanics.quote: Every rocket hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} grants 20% beam charge to all ''{{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger|icononly=yes}} {{ai|H-28Q Apex Turret|Heimerdinger|turrets}}'' within 1000 range, up to a maximum of 100% beam charge when hitting 5 rockets on an enemy champion.

mechanics.claim: Hextech Rocket Swarm fires 4 waves of 5 rockets in quick succession, each wave a separate set of damage instances.
mechanics.quote: unleashes 4 waves of 5 rockets in quick succession that converge upon the target location. Each rocket deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit.
